doc: Zonal drift profile of the default flow for a float32 latitude array: the profile is evaluated in float32 and the constant prof(1.7) subtracted in float64, so the output is float64 holding float32 rounding. Tolerance rtol 2e-5, atol 2e-6: the float64-promoted computation differs by at most 1.6e-7, a one-ulp nudge of the latitudes by 2.5e-7 (0.13 of the default band, the largest relative part next to the zero crossings), tolerance 10 times that.

params.dtype_chain: lat float32: x = |degrees(lat)| / hadley_deg stays float32 (Python floats are weak), prof(x) is float32, prof(np.float64(1.7)) is a float64 scalar and a float32 array minus a float64 scalar is FLOAT64: the stored output is float64 holding float32-rounded prof(x) minus a float64 constant.
